# crit_val_op_bp {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
crit_val_op_bp(w; chart_choice, m=3, alpha=0.05)
```
Return the critical value for the Box-Pierce type ordinal-pattern test statistic computed by [`stat_op_bp`](stat_op_bp.qmd).
 
  * `w::Int`: maximal delay used in the test statistic (supported values depend on the chart).
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`Shannon()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon), [`ShannonExtropy()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), [`DistanceToWhiteNoise()`](DistanceToWhiteNoise.qmd), [`UpDownBalance()`](UpDownBalance.qmd), [`Persistence()`](Persistence.qmd), [`RotationalAsymmetry()`](RotationalAsymmetry.qmd), [`UpDownScaling()`](UpDownScaling.qmd). The critical value does not depend on the logarithm base of [`Shannon`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) and [`ShannonExtropy`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy).
  * `m::Int=3`: length of the ordinal patterns (`2` or `3`, depending on the chart).
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level. For the Shannon-, extropy- and Δ-charts with `m = 3`, tabulated values for `alpha = 0.05` are used.


:::
